items.hook: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 404, carrying 54 people, disappears over the Himalayas after takeoff from Gilgit Airport in Pakistan. The aircraft was never found.
items.body: Pakistan International Airlines Flight 404 was a Fokker F27 Friendship that disappeared shortly after takeoff on 25 August 1989. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: World War II: Battle of Milne Bay: Japanese marines assault Allied airfields at Milne Bay, New Guinea, initiating the Battle of Milne Bay.
items.body: The Battle of Milne Bay, also known as Operation RE or the Battle of Rabi (ラビの戦い) by the Japanese, was a battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Robert Anton Wilson was an American writer, futurist, psychologist, and self-described agnostic mystic.
items.body: Recognized within Discordianism as an Episkopos, pope and saint, Wilson helped publicize Discordianism through his writings and interviews. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Philip III, although suffering from dysentery, becomes King of France following the death of his father Louis IX, during the Eighth Crusade. His uncle, Charles I of Naples, is forced to begin peace negotiations with Muhammad I al-Mustansir, Hafsid Sultan of Tunis.
items.body: Philip III, called the Bold, was King of France from 1270 until his death in 1285. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Diexi earthquake strikes Mao County, Sichuan, China and kills 9,000 people.
items.body: The 1933 Diexi earthquake occurred in Diexi, Mao County, Sichuan, Republic of China on August 25 with a moment magnitude of 7.3 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme). Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Don't Leave Me is a 2009 novel by the Norwegian writer Stig Sæterbakken.
items.body: It tells the story of a 17-year-old boy with a dark personality who falls in love with a woman for the first time, but his fear that she will leave him destroys the relationship. One of those things you can't un-know.
